title: Amazon AWS (2011 - now)
description: I mainly use AWS APIs alongside Java, PHP and NodeJS for the purpose of building web services and server side coding. Additionally, I developed tools for monitoring and launching EC2s, data backups, web deploys, database restructuring, and issuing daily automated e-mails using languages such as Python, Perl and Bash .
